parent_objective: design combined active-set repair/projection using M293 plus M1034 trajectory anchors
blocked_by: M1035 promotes the Candidate B guarded PPO readiness branch to combined active-set repair
invalidates: rerunning M1029 repair without M183/M170 row16 active-set anchor
running longer PPO before combined active-set repair is designed

public_gates: M1036 must not run repair or promote
M1036 must not use private holdout
M1036 must preserve P0 actor inputs
M1036 must specify how M293 and M1034 anchors are combined and gated before replay
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run exact repair from the design milestone
do not drop M997 temporal retention

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: turns exported row16 active-set data into a bounded combined repair/projection plan
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no repair run, no first-replay pass claim, no promotion
stop_condition: stop if M293 and M1034 anchors cannot be combined into one exact-loadable trajectory anchor
stop if the design would relax M997 or exact proof thresholds
stop if the design would change actor inputs
fallback_plan: if combined anchor is feasible, implement a no-PPO combined active-set repair/projection probe next
if combined anchor is not feasible, implement a separate multi-anchor loss path with tests
if both are too broad, route to a finer low-alpha diagnostic projection before another optimizer run

hypothesis: A combined active-set repair/projection design can preserve M997 temporal retention, M297/M270 exact no-regression, M267/M264 row15, and M183/M170 row16 before first replay.
success_criteria: combined anchor or multi-anchor strategy is specified
gate order includes M997, M297/M270, M267/M264 row15, and M183/M170 row16
no PPO repair promotion private holdout or actor-input change occurs
failure_criteria: design omits any hard active-set component
decision_rule: M1036 should admit implementation only if the combined active-set repair/projection gate order is explicit and no update or promotion happens in the design milestone.
